raw_response: {"diagnosis":"15 rows with status 'REVERSAL' carry orig_txn_id pointing to the original transaction. Those originals can still be marked POSTED, because the status filter does not catch them, so they stay in silver and inflate the gold totals for the latest days. The fix excludes any POSTED transaction that a REVERSAL row references. I am assuming each reversal cancels the full original amount, which the evidence does not confirm.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL)"}}
